name: Searing Coral
summary: Searing Coral is a rare, resilient mineral substance harvested from living iron corals off the coast of the Wetlands. Prized by tinkerers and smiths, it possesses remarkable thermal properties that allow it to be smelted and forged into protective armor.

sections.title: A Rare coastal Resource
sections.body: Searing Coral grows exclusively in the chilly ocean waters along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Despite thriving in cold saltwater, this unique marine organism yields a mineral-rich material capable of enduring extreme heat. Harvesters brave the Wetlands' treacherous surf and coastal predators to pry the hardened formations loose.

sections.title: Application in Smithing
sections.body: While traditionally outside standard dwarven metallurgy, Searing Coral caught the attention of inquisitive minds in Ironforge. Gnome craftsmen such as Klockmort Spannerspan adapt the techniques of veteran armorsmith Furen Longbeard, smelting and hammering the coral directly into metal alloys to produce lightweight, exceptionally durable armor for aspiring warriors.

faq.answer: Searing Coral is harvested from the seabed along the shoreline south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. It grows within natural beds of iron coral submerged beneath the shallow coastal waters.

faq.q: Who wants Searing Coral in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan, a gnomish artificer residing in Ironforge's Tinkertown, seeks Searing Coral. He uses it to experiment with smithing methods learned from the legendary dwarven armorer Furen Longbeard.

faq.q: How can coral be forged into armor?
faq.answer: Searing Coral possesses an unusually dense, heat-resistant structure. When smelted in a forge and hammered into metal alloys, it strengthens the composite plating, resulting in exceptionally tough protective gear.

faq.q: Is Searing Coral dangerous to harvest?
faq.answer: The coral itself is safe to gather once located, but harvesting it requires swimming through the open waters off the Wetlands' coast, where wild murlocs and aggressive aquatic beasts roam.

angles.text: Gathering Searing Coral is a crucial step in proving your dedication to Ironforge's master armorers, earning you a custom-forged breastplate designed to withstand heavy frontline combat.
The integration of Searing Coral demonstrates the inventive fusion of gnomish ingenuity and classic dwarven metalworking, turning oceanic minerals into tempered plate.
